about: Front PT0: findings of the pt-BR lint (src/i18n/lint/, profile pt-BR) that are correct Portuguese in one string, each with a reason. Keys are the lint's string ids; `words` are the matched words allowed in that string only, `rules` whole rules, `placeholders` added placeholders.

original:fragment|Meter Radio Telescope.reason: radioIdCaptionText places VIREO's telescope diameter where the translation holds {diameter} (Portuguese puts the number after «Radiotelescópio de»), as Spanish does

original:\" Not Found..reason: VIREO joins a straight opening quote, the search text and this tail (helpNotFoundText, the radio hot list and saved-rows Find); the closing quote must match that untranslated opening one

original:fragment|You have not recorded.reason: VIREO closes this quote with its untranslated tail '".' (PHOTOMETER_RECORD_PIECES.movedTail); the opening quote must match it

map:polish.about.credits.0.reason: the funding agency’s proper name, National Science Foundation, kept in English as in the credits of every language (only that title-case run is allowed)

map:camera.citationIr.reason: the survey’s proper name, Two Micron All Sky Survey (2MASS), kept in English as cited (only that title-case run is allowed)
